brief: Large bulging bloodshot eyes grow all over the cap instead of the white spots. The stalk has no face.
notes: Cap: low-poly dome (8-10 sides). Eyes are REAL protruding low-poly spheres (blob, ~6-8 sides) set into the cap at the concept's positions and continued around the back of the cap (eyes on all sides). Pupils/veins painted (from projection). Stalk with a ragged collar (skirt) and a wider base. Separate parts: cap, eyes, gills (underside), stalk.

brief: Blue stone-crystal hypercube (tesseract) with glowing cracks.
notes: Real frame of square bars: outer cube edges, inner cube edges, and the 8 diagonal connector bars, all as low-poly beams with holes between them. Slightly crooked. Stands on one face. Cracks are painted (glow from the concept colours). Mirror/rotation views work well for the hidden sides since the cube is symmetric.

brief: Emoji-like poop swirl without eyes or face, 3D style with rough pixel texture.
notes: Stacked coils: 3-4 tapering rings/tori (tube along a rising spiral) with a curled tip on top, flat base. Low sides, crooked.

brief: Doll made of tied bundles of straw.
notes: Head bundle, body bundle, arms as one horizontal bundle, two leg bundles with frayed ends; bindings as slightly raised rings. Must stand upright on its leg bundles (flat bottoms) or lean safely; fit height limit. Straw strands painted.

brief: A cut-diamond apple in normal apple colours: red fruit with yellow-green patches, green leaf, brown stem.
notes: Faceted gem apple: few large flat facets (flat shading) like the concept, apple silhouette with top dimple; stem as a thin bent prism; leaf as a thin folded double-sided plate. Base slightly flattened to stand.

brief: Golden jug with one handle, a spout and painted scuffs.
notes: A first version exists at /home/claude/items/06-golden-jug/ (build.py, out/card.jpg) and was judged poor. Fix: the spout must be a soft pulled-out lip like the concept (not a sharp wedge), the rim needs real thickness (rolled lip), handle shape as in the concept (angular strap rising above the shoulder), body proportions, and no streaky texture on the rim/inside. Keep 12 sides.

brief: Silver goblet with large rubies in settings.
notes: Faceted cup (lathe, ~10 sides) with a real hollow and rim thickness, band around the cup, rubies as protruding faceted gems in raised octagonal settings around the band (continue around the back), stem with knot, wide foot.

brief: Living bonsai with large eyes on the trunk in a clay pot.
notes: Shallow clay pot with rim (lathe, oval), soil disc, twisted trunk (tube with varying radii, few sides) splitting into branches, foliage pads as flattened low-poly blobs. Eyes on the trunk as real bulging hemispheres. Fit height carefully.

brief: Classic iPod with wired earbuds and cable wrapped around the body.
notes: Rounded slab body (slightly crooked box), screen and click wheel painted (wheel can be a very shallow raised disc), cable as thin tubes wrapping around the body (real geometry, few sides), two earbuds as small blobs with stems. Must STAND: give it a slight lean back on a small invisible-free footprint or stand on its bottom edge; fit limits.

brief: Trophy cup with two handles on a stand with a plaque.
notes: Brass cup (lathe, real hollow), two loop handles with holes (tubes), stem, square wooden plinth (crooked box) with the '1' plaque painted on a slightly raised plate in front.

brief: Juice carton with the word JUICE (English only).
notes: Gable-top carton: crooked box with a pitched top and a flat fin seam, a screw cap. JUICE lettering and orange graphic must stay readable (front from projection). Back/sides: simple painted panels, no Russian text.

brief: Oxidised bronze with turquoise-green patina and rubbed high points.
notes: Seated meditating figure on a lotus base: head with hair bun, torso, crossed legs as a wide low mass, hands in lap; lotus/round base. Simple big masses, faceted, robe folds painted.

brief: Simple big volumes, painted details (stitches, patches, button eye).
notes: Sitting teddy: head blob with snout and two ears, body, arms, legs pointing forward with foot pads. Button eye can be a tiny raised disc; patches and stitches painted. Paint a back seam on the hidden side.

brief: Wide wooden case with gilded scrolls and painted ornament.
notes: Wide stepped wooden case (crooked boxes), octagonal dial bezel slightly protruding, dial face recessed, crest on top, side scroll volutes as flat-ish extruded shapes, small feet. Scale so width <= 0.26. Back: plain wood panel painted.

brief: Worn metal body, dark leather covering, short faceted lens.
notes: Body box with top plate, protruding faceted lens barrel (lathe along -Y, 8-10 sides) with a recessed glass, viewfinder window block, dials/knobs and lever on top as small cylinders. Back: painted film door.

brief: Brass frame with painted engraving, wooden handle, smoky glass.
notes: On the shelf it should LIE on its side or rest tilted (handle down, lens rim touching) — choose a stable resting pose close to the concept's look, pivot bottom centre, footprint <= 0.26. Polygonal ring frame (tube closed, ~10 sides) with lens disc inside, brass collar, tapered wooden handle with end cap.

brief: Bottle with milk, rubber teat, blue ring and measuring scale.
notes: Faceted bottle (lathe, ~10 sides), blue screw ring, teat on top. Scale marks painted only on one side (as in concept). Milk level painted.

brief: Hard brown case with worn edges, metal locks and a stitched damage.
notes: Standing upright on its bottom edge like the concept shows it (or lying, whichever fits <=0.26 footprint and <=0.22 height — scale it down to fit). Crooked box, metal corner caps slightly raised, handle as a real loop, two locks as small raised blocks. Stitches painted.

brief: Worn olive body, sooty glass, lit wick.
notes: Squat 8-sided fuel tank, glass globe (lathe, 8 sides) — keep it opaque-painted (projected) for now, hood cone with vents painted, two side support tubes, arched wire bail handle (tube), small filler cap, burner. Flame painted on the glass. Fit height: scale whole lamp so height incl. bail <= 0.22.
